observations: Photo 0 shows a black Yamaha PSR-6 electronic keyboard standing upright with standard piano-style keys, control buttons, sliders, and a small display; brand and model are printed on the right panel.
Photo 1 shows the same keyboard lying flat from above, confirming the Yamaha branding, full keybed, and control surface.
A product box is visible beside the keyboard in both photos but its contents are not shown.
